audit.method: Direct model translation followed by a complete source-target editorial reading of all five Elliott cabin event records, including the literary-genre question, piano branches, and farm invitation. Every line, embedded question, response option, conditional branch, gender branch, and Elliott’s literary voice was reviewed in full event context with canonical character and farm terminology. Event commands, actors, movement, timing, friendship changes, response IDs, placeholders, branch delimiters, emotion markers, sound IDs, and non-text payloads were preserved and structurally compared with English. The full-locale final audits remain pending.
